t.zh: Workshop 2 的一道题：知道物体多高、多远，从照片里量出它占多少像素，反推镜头的焦距。照片里量的是像素，相似三角形要的是传感器上的毫米。
t.en: A Workshop 2 exercise: knowing how tall and how far an object is, measure how many pixels it covers in the photo and work back to the lens's focal length. The photo gives pixels; similar triangles want millimetres on the sensor.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：像素和毫米怎样换算，才能代进相似三角形？传感器高 smm 毫米、spx 像素；物体在图里高 hpx 像素，实际高 H、距离 Z（毫米）。
t.en: This level asks: how are pixels and millimetres converted before the similar triangles? The sensor is smm millimetres and spx pixels high; the object covers hpx pixels and is H tall and Z away, in millimetres.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：先把像素换成传感器上的毫米，再代进 h/f = H/Z。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="pixel-to-mm-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: convert pixels to millimetres on the sensor first, then h/f = H/Z; pixels and millimetres never share a proportion.

brief.zh: 输入 hpx、spx、smm、Z、H：交出焦距 f（毫米）。
brief.en: Given hpx, spx, smm, Z and H, give the focal length f in millimetres.

hint.zh: 一个像素在传感器上有多少毫米？
hint.en: How many millimetres of sensor is one pixel?
